## Sequences

A sequence is a function $a: \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}$, written $(a_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$.

- $a_n = 1/n$: $1, \frac{1}{2}, \frac{1}{3}, \ldots$
- $F_{n+2} = F_{n+1} + F_n$: $1, 1, 2, 3, 5, \ldots$

## Convergence

$(a_n)$ converges to $a$ if for every $\varepsilon > 0$ there is an $N$ with $|a_n - a| < \varepsilon$ for all $n \geq N$.
